question: Guru Bipin Singh, a Nrityacharya awardee, Sangeet Natak Akademi awardee and Kalidas Samman awardee, was renowned for promoting which classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh:-**

 
 
• He​** **was a** renowned dance exponent** and **teacher** from **Manipur, India.**
 
• He was instrumental in promoting and popularizing the **Manipuri dance** form across the country and the world.
 
• He trained several students and established the** Manipuri Nartanalaya in New Delhi **to impart training in the dance form.
 
• Guru Bipin Singh received several prestigious awards for his contributions to the field of dance, including the **Nrityacharya, Sangeet Natak Akademi, and Kalidas Samman awards.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kuchipudi **

 
 
• It is a classical dance form from** Andhra Pradesh,** India.
 
• It is known for its **intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressive storytelling.**
 
 
 
• **Odissi:-**
 
 
• It** **is a classical dance form from** Odisha,** India.
 
• It is characterized by **fluid movements, intricate hand gestures, and elaborate costumes.**
 
 
 
• **Kathak:-**
 
 
• It​ is a classical dance form from** northern India, **known for its** rhythmic footwork, intricate hand movements, and storytelling** through dance.
